text:
Happy are you, O Nile, born unwitnessed and of unknown parents, cloud and river, making tree and wheat fertile.


The moisture the raging Dog drinks thirstily from sacred rivers he lavishly adds to your fords, Aquarius becoming Leo for you.


No otherwise, Lisis, does it happen to the watery urns of my eyes, whose unknown source remains unspoken.


For when the Sirius of your red bonds burns in blushes of fresh gold, their flood, your ice, and my grief increase.

translation.title: As the Nile Conceals Its Source
